description: This file defines the BatchClient class for interacting with the AWS Batch service in PHP. It extends the AwsClient class and declares method annotations for various AWS Batch operations, including both synchronous and asynchronous methods.

classes.name: BatchClient
classes.description: A client class used to perform operations with the AWS Batch service.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels a job in AWS Batch.

methods.name: createComputeEnvironment
methods.description: Creates a new compute environment in AWS Batch.

methods.name: createJobQueue
methods.description: Creates a new job queue in AWS Batch.

methods.name: createSchedulingPolicy
methods.description: Creates a new scheduling policy in AWS Batch.

methods.name: getJobQueueSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the job queue.

methods.name: submitJob
methods.description: Submits a job to AWS Batch.
